title: How long you look back changes the jobless rate
sources: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), National Statistics Office, concepts and definitions

quiz.q: Current weekly status measures activity over:
quiz.why: Right. A reference week of 7 days.

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: Were you unemployed last week? Or last year?
The answer changes India's jobless rate.

beats.say: Were you unemployed last week? Or last year? The answer changes India's jobless rate.

lines.say: Usual status asks what you mostly did over the past year.
Current weekly status asks about just the past seven days.

beats.say: Usual status asks what you mostly did over the past year. Current weekly status asks about just the past seven days.

lines.say: The Periodic Labour Force Survey began in 2017.
It replaced the older five-yearly employment surveys of the N-S-S-O.

beats.say: The Periodic Labour Force Survey began in 2017. It replaced the older five-yearly employment surveys of the N-S-S-O.

lines.say: Labour force participation counts those working or looking for work.
The unemployment rate is the share of that labour force without work.
